entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return some cycling shoes. Order number is VF78-22-B14.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF78-22-B14. I see the order here. Before we proceed, can I just clarify the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Look, I don't have time for a big back-and-forth. The shoes give me blisters, the pressure point right above the cleats is unbearable. Can I get a refund, yes or no?
Understood. Let me just check the delivery date. It looks like you received them 55 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Great. So you'll approve the return?

Yes, absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just pack the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, I see the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
